manuscript.title: CoNP-completeness of binary directed chip-firing reachability

claim_scope: Ordinary sequential legal chip-firing reachability, empty and nonmaximal words allowed, finite nonempty loopless strongly connected directed multigraphs, binary adjacency multiplicities, nonnegative binary initial/target configurations, invalid encodings rejected; coNP-complete under deterministic polynomial-time many-one reductions. Singleton handled separately.

proof_status.finite_cutoff: verified by conservation, finite repetition and dichotomy
proof_status.all_order_prefix_and_cleanup: verified exact strict estimates and independent-reserve proof
proof_status.arbitrary_target_counts: verified marker forces first gate after N old moves, no unique odometer/recurrence premise
proof_status.total_reduction_and_bit_complexity: verified polynomial binary encoding; no trajectory output
proof_status.credited_membership: verified primitive period, reduced integer solution, deletion, proper blocking certificate and polynomial bit bound
proof_status.primary_imports: directly inspected exact relevant bodies, models and historical Problem19; five PDFs hash-bound

independence.incidental_exposure: Current manuscript disclosure/attribution/status paragraphs and current helper comments; historical filenames only enumerated/hashed. These were not adopted as verdict evidence.

limitations: Not a result for simple graphs, unary encodings, bounded degrees/chips, fixed graph size or arbitrary signed reachability membership.
No polynomial trajectory length claim; binary numerical sizes may be exponential.
Finite controls corroborate universal written proof; no proof-assistant certification or external human peer review.
Only specified relevant primary scopes read; standard imported complexity and integer-linear-algebra results are not recursively re-proved.
